experiment: VALORANT rank-tier predictability from aggregated ranked statistics (val_stats.csv)
conclusion: 99.9% of players in this file are Immortal 1–3 or Radiant. The best model (Logistic Regression) reaches 60.5% accuracy versus 59.8% for always predicting the most common tier (a gain of 0.7 percentage points; macro-F1 0.29). The aggregated stats barely separate rank tiers at the top of the ladder, so no rank/MMR model is deployed for VALORANT; the professional vlr.gg dataset is used for a Performance Rating model instead.
